answer: Work waits on the nebula until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the sparrow of the next round. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the thread of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
